title: WELCOME TO 5TH ECHELON
description: Co-op and Spies vs Mercs are back, on free community servers. Press F5 in the game for your friends, friend requests and invites.

title: NO VPN NEEDED
description: Play from anywhere. When your router can't take connections, your matches go through the server's relay on their own.

title: YOUR FRIENDS FOLLOW YOU
description: Your identity carries your name and friends to every server in the community network. The launcher shows friends on other servers, one click from joining them.

title: HOST A SERVER
description: A server takes one script on a small Linux VPS. Join the community network, or run one just for your group.

title: FOUND A BUG?
description: Tell us on GitHub, with the launcher's and the game's logs if you can.
